title: §.XIV open: POSTREMUM MEMBRUM — in what sense some want to be saluted AC theologians; characteristic notes
pass_a_gloss: §. XIV. The LAST MEMBER of our Annotation remains to be made clear: In what Sense some, above the rest, desire to be saluted as Theologians of the Augsburg Confession, and salute themselves as such? So that we may dispatch this in three words, as they say, we will give them designated by certain Characteristic Notes and present them to be looked upon. They are therefore as follows.
pass_b_english: §. XIV. One last member of this Annotation still needs clearing: in what sense do some men — more than others — want to be greeted as Augsburg Confession theologians, and greet themselves that way?
To put it in three words, as the saying goes, we will mark them by a few characteristic notes and set them out to be seen.
source_text:
§. XIV.
POSTREMUM Annotationis nostrae MEMBRUM dilucidandum restat: Quô Sensu nonnulli, prae caeteris, Augustanae Confessionis Theologi salutari cupiant, seque salutent ipsos? Hoc ut tribus, quod aiunt, verbis expediamus, Characteristicis quibusdam Notis designatos eos dabimus praebebimusque conspiciendos. Sunt itaque
